gemini.title: Ireland Osm Roads
gemini.abstract:
DATASET: OpenStreetMap Ireland Extract. 
SOURCE: Generated by the OpenStreetMap community and provided by Geofabrik GmbH. 
LICENSE: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. 
ATTRIBUTION: "© OpenStreetMap contributors". 
LINEAGE: Data downloaded as .gpkg and imported into PostGIS. 
LEGAL: You are free to copy, distribute, transmit and adapt this data, as long as you credit OpenStreetMap and its contributors. If you alter or build upon this data, you may distribute the result only under the same license.
gemini.lineage: Published by OpenStreetMap contributors as part of OpenStreetMap. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: osm_id
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned by the OpenStreetMap database.

columns.name: fclass
columns.description: The primary classification of the road (e.g., motorway, primary, residential).

columns.name: name
columns.description: The local name of the road (often in English or Irish depending on local tagging).

columns.name: ref
columns.description: The official road reference number (e.g., M50, N11, R132).

columns.name: oneway
columns.description: Traffic flow direction: "F" (Forward/With Digitizing), "T" (Towards/Against Digitizing), or "B" (Both).

columns.name: maxspeed
columns.description: The posted speed limit in km/h.

columns.name: irlosmr_pk
columns.description: Primary-key identifier for records in irl_osm_roads.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Geometry column: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84) or EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) depending on import settings.
